title: ThundR Design Standard
sampled: RDRAGON / ThundR on the 17e, ENGINE 1.0.4.35–1.0.4.37, from owner screenshots on 2026-11-11. Hex values are the dominant exact pixels, not approximations.
law: This is the look and interface going forward. Apply with signed incremental updates only. Do not complete-rebuild an app to adopt it. Updates may only add functions, never remove them.
supersedes_look: YA-DESIGN-TOKENS-0.1 Stormclay claymation is not the look for new or incremental UI. Those older tokens stay on disk; this standard is what to use.

removed_from_chrome.what: The row of CHAT, ASSM, RMAIL, ЯWALLET, and >ThundR buttons immediately above the composer (the chat box).
removed_from_chrome.still_available: Those seats are not removed as functions. Reach them from the hamburger menu and the GHOSTMACHINE tab.

bg.use: Twilight ground. The whole surface is black, with stars painted on top.

green.use: Primary phosphor: chat text, bot-bubble border, key outlines, composer border, + button, prompt R:\>

greenEngine.use: ENGINE label in the header when healthy.

greenDim.use: Dim green, anti-alias and secondary borders.

mint.use: GHOSTMACHINE tab lettering; also light mint highlights.

engineAlert.use: ENGINE label when it needs attention (as in ENGINE 1.0.4.36 with a pending bind).

chrome.use: App name (RDRAGON), body text on purple panels, keycap letters.

muted.use: Version number, 'via parser / via casket / via local'.

purple.use: Action purple: Send, return, EN (selected), user-bubble border. CSS name BlueViolet, exact match.

purplePill.use: moves / help / heal / approve pills on the ThundR panel.

gold.use: ThundR status ('ThundR - idle', 'ThundR - awake') and 'ThundR · iOS' title.

cyan.use: Command text inside the ThundR panel ('request approval terraformr bind').

botBubbleFill.use: Bot / ThundR message bubble fill, a near-black with a hint of green at the rim (#0C150A).

rfont.name: RFONT
rfont.role: The named UI face for this standard — chat, prompts, header, RBOARD labels.
rfont.file: fonts/RFONT.ttf or fonts/RFONT.otf — drop the official file here. It was not in the box library when this pack was made.

chrome.header: Hamburger (green rounded square) · app name in #EEEEEE · app portrait · ENGINE in greenEngine or engineAlert · version in muted.
chrome.twilight: Pure #000000 with sparse small stars: mostly white, some #39FF14, a few dim purple. No horizon line required on phone chat.
chrome.botBubble: Green #39FF14 rounded border, fill botBubbleFill, text #39FF14 in RFONT/VT323. Gold 'ThundR - idle' or 'ThundR - awake' sits on the top-left rim.
chrome.userBubble: Fill #1A0630, border #8A2BE2 with #B388FF highlight, chrome text, ThundR sprite at the left. Label 'You: …'.
chrome.thundrPanel: Rounded panel, fill #110D1C, border #2B2160, gold title '⚡ ThundR · iOS', pill actions, cyan commands, muted 'via …' lines, purple 'approve…' in the footer. ThundR never approves by itself; Face ID on a HARD device signs.
chrome.ghostmachine: Vertical tab, right edge, fill #117733, mint #CCFFEE lettering, rounded on the inner corners.
chrome.composer: + button (green border, green plus) · field with 'R:\> Message your bot' in green · purple Send. No button row above this bar.
chrome.rboard: See assets/icons/rboard-reference.jpg. Purple outer frame, green-outlined black keys, white letters, green Baybayin superscripts, purple return and selected EN, blue globe, wide RBOARD space key, 'R:\>' prompt with a block cursor.
